modified_caption: The line plot illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods over several epochs, represented by the metric 'WER' (Word Error Rate) on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled 'epoch,' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with integer tick labels for each epoch. The y-axis is labeled 'WER,' with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. The line marked with circular markers and a solid line style is color-coded in gray, representing 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4.' It starts at approximately 70 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 40 at epoch 6, showing a general downward trend. The line with square markers and a solid style represents 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' and follows a similar pattern, starting around 60 WER and ending below 35. The dashed line with circular markers represents 'tiny int4,' starting approximately 70 and decreasing to below 45 by epoch 6. The line with square markers and a dashed style, coded as 'tiny int8,' begins at 60, declining steadily to reach 40 at the end. Finally, the line with triangular markers and a dotted style indicates 'tiny full,' starting just below 30 and showing a slight downward trend, ending near 28 at epoch 6. Overall, the plot highlights the trajectory of WER across epochs for each method, with 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' consistently outperforming 'tiny full' across all epochs. A legend is placed at the top right corner of the plot.
